description:
`packages/python/default.nix:32` sets `dontFixup = true`, but lines 34-41 add `autoPatchelfHook` plus `cc.cc.lib` and `zlib` for Linux. `autoPatchelfHook` runs during the fixup phase, which `dontFixup` skips, so the Linux interpreter is never patched and those inputs have no effect.

Found by the EGM drift review on 2026-10-25. Not yet reproduced on Linux.

## Acceptance

- On x86_64-linux, either the build log shows autoPatchelf running and `ldd result/bin/python3` resolves every library from the store, or the hook and inputs are removed with a comment explaining why they are not needed.
- Existing python drvPaths stay unchanged, or the change lands as a new builder variant.
title: python: dontFixup disables autoPatchelfHook on Linux
